# has bin

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasBin`](gmeow-hasBin.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasBin>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/aggregation`](../../slices/aggregation.md)
